notes: Clauses about life span, death, named diseases and physical defects are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy; affected rules list them in 'dropped'.

skipped.reason: Eye defects, blindness and speech defects: medical, excluded.

variants.text: The 2nd lord in the 2nd, an angle or a trine: it promotes wealth.
The 2nd lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th: losses of wealth.
A benefic in the 2nd house gives wealth.
A malefic in the 2nd house erodes wealth.

rules.text: Jupiter, the significator of wealth, in the 2nd house or with Mars: wealthy.
The 2nd and 11th lords exchange houses, or are together in an angle or trine: the person will possess wealth.
The 2nd lord in an angle with the 11th lord in a trine from it, or Jupiter joined or aspected by Venus: gains of wealth in full measure.
The 2nd and 11th lords are both in the 6th with malefics on the 2nd and 11th, or both are combust or with malefics: persistent financial hardship.
The 2nd and 11th lords in the 6th, 8th or 12th, with Mars in the 11th and Rahu in the 2nd: loss of wealth through penalties from government.
Jupiter in the 11th, Venus in the 2nd, the 2nd lord with a benefic and a benefic in the 12th: money is spent on religious and charitable causes.
The 2nd lord in its own or exalted sign: famous, generous and a well-wisher of others, someone who looks after people.
The 2nd lord with a malefic and a malefic in the 2nd house: a tendency to gossip and to bend the truth.
The 2nd lord exalted or in its own sign and aspected by Jupiter: popular and well known.
